highlights.title: Kosmos has its own iPad layouts
highlights.line: Sideways, an iPad shows Agents and Projects side by side (its View switch changes only that iPad); upright, cards go two across.

highlights.title: Decision tasks say who needs you
highlights.line: A task in Needs Your Decision now names the agent waiting on you, when one is, and why.

highlights.title: Kosmos restarts behind the app you use
highlights.line: From the next update on, when Kosmos restarts itself onto a new version while another app is in front, it opens behind that app.

highlights.title: The Agents list fits a narrow window
highlights.line: In a narrow browser window, the Agents list shows each running agent's role and AI model under its name, not cut short.

highlights.title: Quiet runs of a recurring task roll up
highlights.line: Runs of a recurring task that found nothing new fold into one row in its history; the task says when something last changed.
